searchText: <@755590043632140352> <@363800010518822915> is there a consensus spec draft that I can read for the IL EIP (7547)? <@415109946682769408> is preparing one, but it's essentially what's included in my ePBS PR, you need to extract those functions and port them to the system without ePBS There's also <@363800010518822915>'s ethresear.ch post with this https://ethresear.ch/t/specing-out-forward-inclusion-list-w-dedicated-gas-limits/17115 This version is for the dedicated gas limit. It's still not clear to me which inclusion list version EIP7547 is guiding towards <@750824368438771842> is working on showing the spec diff of EIP-7547: https://github.com/michaelneuder/consensus-specs/pull/17 A more comprehensive write-up is in progress ya turns out the cl spec changes just arent that big. most of the logic would be in the p2p spec and the block validation in the EL. working on a doc outlining some of the design considerations around ILs! Do the CL specs include a [`py.typed`](https://peps.python.org/pep-0561/#packaging-type-information) file? <@415109946682769408> <@750824368438771842> For inclusion list, I've done a bit of the writing on validator and p2p spec here: https://github.com/terencechain/consensus-specs/pull/1/files#diff-2200acbac5090bf758b5b92d0c89a97a3ee198347ef97c08304ad03e3ece4f50 Feel free to take a look and grab whatever
